title: Rope, grappling hooks and ziplines
body:
Made possible by the Species mod:

* Rope is crafted from three string, can be placed on blocks for decoration, and can be connected between fences
* Grappling Hooks let you hook onto the block above you, giving you an escape option in taller caves

Connect a rope between two fences on a downward slope to make a zipline, then ride it using the Grappling Hook. It's fast transportation, but it only goes one way.
